        for r in range(last_start, H):
            for c in range(W):
                val = grid[r][c]
                if val != bg and val != 3:
                    # Calculate relative row in last section
                    rel_r = r - last_start
                    
                    # Copy to all other sections at same relative row
                    for s_start, _ in sections[:-1]:
                        target_r = s_start + rel_r
                        out[target_r][c] = val
    
    return out
